description: A committed, permanent local example of the ai-3d-factory workflow: a single-color desk nameplate with raised text, generated with `factory generate-openscad --template nameplate`. This is a demo/reference project living under examples/, not a real order - see examples/simple-nameplate/README.md.
constraints: Original design only - no franchise/copyrighted logos or characters (see docs/licensing-policy.md).
Demo scale only (90mm x 30mm base plate, from the built-in nameplate template) - not sized against any real desk or nameplate holder.
This is a workflow example, not a print order: no STL has been exported, and this example is not slicer_review_ready, human_approved, or print_ready.
